title: [NativeFace B2] Arrange Crèche form and Plot choices in bounded responsive panels
body:
Parent: #5357. Related #5606 (finite native region layout, already closed), #5607 (focus/overflow), #5365 (checked component recipes), #5364 (Face/Fore/Look separation). Second quick win from the 2026-10-18 real QEMU Crèche review.

## Outcome
The large normal QEMU viewport uses meaningful **two-column Crèche composition**, with Body name/naming controls grouped together and search/starting Plot inventory grouped together. The summary/primary Birth action stays conspicuous and reachable. A narrow or constrained viewport collapses to one column without losing source meaning, actions or details.

## Current starting point (reuse, don't rewrite)
- `targets/conduitos/src/native_face_scene/layout.rs::admit_with_expression` already accepts 1–2 columns, measured text and bounded pagination, auto-collapsing below 640 px. `NativeFaceScene::prepare_configured` uses an admitted component recipe; generic `prepare` still chooses 1 column.
- Existing layout fills sequential columns on overflow; that alone doesn't provide deliberate side-by-side semantic groups.
- The source remains `plots/birth/src/face/projection.rs`; #5606 closed 2026-10-18. Verify actual installed `NativeFaceMask`/Crèche path before selecting configured geometry.

## Implementation slice
1. Trace the installed native Crèche path and its selected Face/recipe/Look/Host. Select or admit an existing *checked structural recipe* for named regions: (a) Body identity and naming fields/actions, (b) searchable starting Plot choices, (c) review/readiness and prominent offered Birth action. Don't hardcode a Crèche-specific meaning catalogue in `layout.rs`.
2. Measure and lay out genuine groups in two bounded columns at a usable wide extent (e.g. 1280×800), not mere successive rows that happen to overflow into column two. On narrow widths use a predictable one-column order, with disclosed pagination/continuation as necessary.
3. Provide distinguishable title, editable name, section headings, checklist labels, secondary suggestion/search, ready/unavailable summary, one obvious Birth affordance and footer input hints only if current binding supports them.
4. Keep each item, current action, typed argument and revision attached to its original Face. Preserve authored meaningful order and keyboard traversal even if visual placement differs. Readable details remain inspectable, including off-page/overflow items.
5. Use the admitted Phosphor/Look and measured proportional Unicode; constrain scene commands/text and compositor surfaces. No HTML/CSS engine, window manager, cloned application state, magic coordinates or unapproved scene-budget expansion.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Source-pinned normal QEMU Crèche at 1280×800 visibly uses coherent Body and Plot panels side by side; not a raw, flattened long list or simple overflow columns.
- [ ] A smaller supported viewport shows correct one-column collapse with explicit continuation and accessible offscreen actions, with a long Unicode Body name and more than four Plots tested.
- [ ] Keyboard traversal/Tab and pointer interactions reach every offered control in meaningful source order; Birth is prominent, never duplicated, and disabled/unavailable/refusal state is truthfully rendered.
- [ ] Current Face/Mask/Show/Host and accepted action identities are unchanged by layout; source/renderer evidence compares pre/post geometry for equal semantic truth.
- [ ] Normal and failed layout admission respect 48 GraphicsScene commands, 192-byte command text, finite retained surfaces and deterministic fallback, with focused tests and real QEMU screenshots.

## Stop line
Layout/structural composition belongs below Face; Look only styles it. Do not reopen #5606 from scratch or build a new universal grid API; prefer a dedicated small PR coordinated with #5607 and #5520.
